title: school bus truck int horn honk
author: kyles
changes: A real school bus horn, 'beep-beep, beeeep', recorded from inside the bus. Trimmed to 0.00–2.62 s of the original, mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 70 Hz, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. Taken from the Freesound high-quality MP3 preview of the recording. The 70 Hz high-pass removes the measured low thump of the horn button and cab.
